dct_alternative_sm: Natural color image mosaics of Afghanistan
dct_description_sm: "The 50 tiled images in this dataset are natural-color renditions of the calibrated six-band Landsat mosaics created from Landsat Enhanced Thematic Mapper Plus (ETM+) data" -- DVD-ROM insert.
Also available via Internet from the USGS web site. Address as of 8/22/07: http://pubs.usgs.gov/ds/2007/245/; current access via PURL.
Contributors: Davis, Philip A. (Philip Arthur), 1950-; Geological Survey (U.S.); Hare, Trent M.; United States. Agency for International Development.
On container: "In cooperation with the U.S. Agency for International Development."
Publication statement: [Reston, VA] : U.S. Dept. of the Interior, U.S. Geological Survey, 2007.
System requirements: UNIX or Linux workstation, MacIntosh or IBM-compatible PC; CD-ROM drive; and 256 colors display monitor.
dct_title_s: Natural-color image mosaics of Afghanistan digital databases and maps
gbl_displayNote_sm: Based on LOC maps search metadata, including embedded catalog fields. Full item enrichment and collection reconciliation remain pending.
